objective: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Young Panthers.

description: If you want to be a part of the hunt with this crack group under Hemet's leadership, you're going to need to prove yourself an able panther hunter.  We'll start you out easy -- don't you worry.  Let's see you kill 10 young panthers to start.
Tracking them down is only half the challenge...
progress: A true panther hunter would be out in the fields, trying to stalk his prey. Show some commitment to your goal, <class>, and get back out there.
